outcome: anti-CMV antibody levels (IgG and IgM) in mothers and neonates
clinical features of CMV infection in neonates
finding: While anti-CMV IgG transmission to neonates is associated with gender and type of delivery, there was no evidence of vertical transmission of CMV despite active infection in some mothers.
mod_finding: The concentration of anti-CMV IgG in neonates with normal delivery was significantly lower than with cesarean delivery.
